summary: 全仓测试覆盖率补救计划 — P0 回归保护 + P1 endpoint/API 覆盖 + P2 深度+基线
approach: 按风险优先级分 3 wave 补测试：Wave 1 补 P0 回归保护（store slices + MCP endpoints），Wave 2 补 P1 backend endpoints + frontend API/stores，Wave 3 补 P1-P2 浅层深化 + hooks + 覆盖率基线。遵循 companion pattern 扩展现有测试，使用 vitest 3.2.4 + @vitest/coverage-v8。

data_flow.diagram: Wave1[P0 regression guards] → Wave2[P1 backend+frontend coverage] → Wave3[P1-P2 depth+baseline]
stages: P0 regression guard tests for critical slices and endpoints
P1 backend endpoint tests and frontend API/store coverage
P1-P2 shallow test deepening, hooks coverage, and coverage baseline measurement

design_decisions: Companion pattern for all new tests: .additional.test.ts and .branches.additional.test.ts (per Locked constraint #1)
P0 priority fixed: skillsSlice + conversationSlice + learning endpoint + workspace endpoint first (per Locked constraint #2)
Tests verify meaningful scenarios, not coverage numbers (per Locked constraint #4)
E2E tests (R-004) deferred to separate plan — out of scope
Zustand slice test harness follows createHarness()/getLiveStore() pattern from projectSlice.additional.test.ts
MCP endpoint tests follow makeRequest() + direct import pattern from memory-endpoints.test.ts
Frontend API bridge tests follow vi.hoisted + vi.mock('./core') pattern from knowledge.test.ts
Wave ordering reflects genuine dependencies: Wave 2 coverage baseline reasoning benefits from Wave 1 test files existing

patterns: Zustand slice harness pattern (createStore/getLiveStore/createHarness with SetFn type alias)
MCP endpoint test pattern (makeRequest helper + direct dynamic import)
callApi bridge test pattern (vi.hoisted mock + vi.mock('./core') + beforeEach reset)
conventions: vitest describe/it blocks with descriptive names
beforeEach: vi.clearAllMocks() or mockReset() per test file
Type alias: type SetFn = Parameters<typeof createXxxSlice>[0]
MCP tests: makeRequest(body) helper returning HttpRequest shape

pressure_pass.reason: Highest complexity — M25 endpoint tests with service mocking (RevisionServiceImpl, WorldviewExtractor)
pressure_pass.result: PASS — read_first covers source + protocol + extractor; convergence has 9 grep-verifiable criteria; implementation steps specify mock patterns and exact endpoint handler names

residual_risks: TASK-005 hook discovery may reveal different files than expected
TASK-006 coverage-v8 may OOM on large codebase
